cd /workspace/project && timeout 400 python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re,html,ssl
cands={
 "nano-gpt.com":"NanoGPT",
 "redpill.ai":"RedPill",
 "refuseless.ai":"Refuseless",
 "uncensured.ai":"UncensuredAI",
 "abliteration.ai":"Abliteration",
 "heabsy.ai":"Heabsy",
 "lebrel.ai":"Lebrel",
 "openuncensored.com":"OpenUncensored",
}
for dom,name in cands.items():
    for scheme in ["https"]:
        u=f"{scheme}://{dom}"
        try:
            r=urllib.request.Request(u,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/131.0"})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=25) as x:
                s=x.read().decode(errors="ignore"); code=x.status
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: s=e.read().decode(errors="ignore")[:3000]; code=e.code
        except Exception as e: print(f"{name:16} {dom:22} ERR {type(e).__name__}"); break
        txt=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); txt=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',txt,flags=re.S)
        txt=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',txt)); txt=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',txt)
        hits=[k for k in ["free","credit","trial","$5","$1 ","no sign","no account","sign up","signup","api key"] if k.lower() in txt.lower()]
        snip=""
        for m in re.finditer(r'(free|credit|trial)',txt,re.I):
            snip=txt[max(0,m.start()-70):m.start()+110]; break
        print(f"{name:16} {dom:22} {code} | kata: {','.join(hits)}")
        if snip: print(f"     …{snip.strip()[:150]}")
        break
PY
